intent: Format A, three variants. Establishes that Format A cannot supply a variant-scope attribute, so the Q-6a measurement can separate a format limit from a scoring effect. Counterfactual category is apparel.
coverage_note: Asserts the uncategorized applicability this fixture was authored for: the category gap charged once at IDENT.PRODUCT_TYPE_OR_CATEGORY, and VARIANT.ATTRIBUTE_COVERAGE removed on its documented ground. Checks whose predicates remain unimplemented are deliberately not asserted here.
notes: Format A capability probe, not a mirror of unc-07. csv_input promotes every metafield at product scope and has no variant-scope attribute route at all, so VARIANT.ATTRIBUTE_COVERAGE cannot reach PASS from Format A under any category. Recorded rather than worked around.
